announcements.text: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding outcome of the Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026 wherein the Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.text: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding execution of definitive agreements to acquire 100% stake in a Malaysian printed-circuit-board assembler for a consideration of Rs. 640 crore, subject to regulatory approvals.
announcements.label: M&A
announcements.line: Buying 100% of a Malaysian PCB assembler for ₹640 cr (all-cash, pending approvals): first overseas manufacturing base.

announcements.subject: Litigation/ Dispute/ Regulatory Action
announcements.text: Indian Energy Exchange Limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of an order from the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission directing implementation of market coupling for the day-ahead market in a phased manner beginning January 2027. The Company is evaluating legal remedies.
announcements.label: Legal & regulatory
announcements.line: CERC orders phased market coupling in the day-ahead market from Jan 2027 — directly threatens IEX's price-discovery moat. Company weighing legal options.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.text: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the press release titled 'L&T wins a mega order for a 765 kV transmission project'. As per the Company's classification, a mega order is valued above Rs. 7,000 crore.
announcements.label: Press release
announcements.line: Mega order (>₹7,000 cr) for a 765 kV transmission project; L&T's 'mega' band is its largest order class.

announcements.subject: Credit Rating
announcements.text: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding S&P Global Ratings has revised the outlook on the Company's long-term issuer credit rating to Positive from Stable; rating affirmed at BBB-.
announcements.label: Credit rating
announcements.line: S&P lifts outlook to Positive (rating affirmed BBB-): a step toward cheaper offshore borrowing.
